product.name: Cheddar App
product.description: A mobile app that enables users to make instant person-to-person payments and earn cashback by purchasing gift cards from various retailers.

product.name: Reloadable Gift Cards
product.description: Digital gift cards for major UK retailers that can be topped up repeatedly and used for in-store or online purchases.

product.name: Cashback on Gift Card Purchases
product.description: A service that provides instant cashback rewards when users buy gift cards through the Cheddar app for various retailers.
